'''Pharoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A [[Major/Legends|major]] of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] military forces, he was stationed at the [[Outpost Bolym]] in the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]].<ref name="TOR" />

In [[3643 BBY]] he ordered a team to install a prototype [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]. This task was not fulfilled as the team was almost wiped out. Only [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ascercia]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Virne]] survived.<ref name="TOR" />
